CustomField.description: Human-readable name of the checklist group, mirroring Task_Group_Def__mdt.Group_Name__c. Denormalised onto the record on purpose so a report or list view can show the group name without a Custom Metadata join, which SOQL cannot do against a __mdt from a report.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Name of this checklist group as it appears in the checklist UI. System-populated from the group definition.
CustomField.label: Group Name
